title: 5/16" Female Quick Disconnect Fuel Adapter
lead: MOC has developed a new fuel adapter. This new Quick Disconnect adapter is deeper allowing it to connect to fuel systems with longer stems.
body: This adapter has been confirmed to fit the newer Toyota Highlanders.
